program.name: Pairs and AMRAP
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: Bodyweight supersets, then a short AMRAP, for strength and a sweat without gear.
program.about: Strength first, then the sweat. Two bodyweight supersets of a push or pull with a leg move come first, then a short AMRAP of two moves, as many rounds as you can. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Supersets, then a short AMRAP, A / B, no gear
